text: Model List Search 是一个面向 DSH 网页端的界面插件，会在模型选择菜单中加入搜索框。用户输入文字后，插件按模型按钮的标题和文本内容进行不区分大小写的过滤，并隐藏没有匹配项的分组；没有结果时会显示提示。打开模型菜单时搜索框自动获得焦点，也可按斜杠聚焦、按 Escape 清除搜索。它通过观察页面新增节点处理动态出现的菜单，并提供卸载清理。适合模型列表较长、希望快速定位模型的网页端用户；代码未配置密钥或外部服务。

Model List Search adds search to the DSH web model picker. Typing filters by model title and text, hides empty groups, and reports no matches. Slash focuses search; Escape clears it. It handles menus added later.
想在网页端的模型列表里直接搜索模型。
模型选项太多了，能不能输入名称快速筛选？
Help me find a model in the web picker by typing its name.
Model List Search 的功能「模型菜单搜索过滤」：在 DSH 网页模型菜单中输入关键词后，按模型选项标题和文本筛选，并隐藏不含匹配项的分组；无匹配时显示提示。打开菜单自动聚焦，也可用斜杠聚焦、Escape 清空。
Filter web model options by title and text as you type; slash focuses search and Escape clears it.
@nathan/dsh-model-list-search README · dsh-model-list-search：A client-only DeepSeek Harness plugin that adds a **Search models…** field to the composer model picker.

@nathan/dsh-model-list-search README · Behavior：- Focuses the search field when the picker opens to its model list.
- Filters model names and descriptions as you type, case-insensitively.
- Preserves provider headings only when they contain a matching model.
- Press `/` to focus search; press `Escape` once to clear the query.
- Does not change model configuration or selection behavior.

@nathan/dsh-model-list-search README · Install：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add /Users/nathan/dsh-plugins/dsh-model-list-search
```

Restart DSH Desktop after installation. Then open the composer model picker, choose **Model**, and start typing.
